description: Reviewer evaluation rules. Align with evaluation_rubric_v1.json (v1.1) for dimensions and verdict logic.

diligence_red_flags.label: Missing founding team details
diligence_red_flags.action: Add to diligence_red_flags when founding team information is absent.

diligence_red_flags.label: Missing revenue or traction data
diligence_red_flags.action: Add to diligence_red_flags when revenue/ARR/traction data is absent.

diligence_red_flags.label: Competitive landscape unclear
diligence_red_flags.action: Add to diligence_red_flags when specific competitors are not identified.

diligence_red_flags.label: Missing valuation data
diligence_red_flags.action: Add to diligence_red_flags when valuation information is absent.

diligence_red_flags.label: Gap ≥4 between highest and lowest dimension
diligence_red_flags.action: Flag for human review or LLM fallback.

hypothesis_feedback_guidance: Review Scout primary_thesis, key_assumptions, and biggest_unknown. In assumption_feedback: comment on which assumptions are well-supported or weak, and highlight critical unknowns that could invalidate the thesis. Use only information provided; do not hallucinate missing data.
